full_judgment:
207. PW 13 Dafader Shafiuddin (Retd) of Lancer Unit, who used to drive the Jeep of the Unit at the material time.stated that Risalder Nawab Ali informed him about the night parade in the evening on 14-8-75 and at about 8-30 PM their night parade was made to fall-in by RDM Ershad and ultimately by rotation the parade was made over to Major Farook Rahman, II-IC (Second in Command) as commanding officer Lieutenant Colonel Momen was on leave and Major Syed Farook Rahman was the Commanding Officer-in-Charge. The night parade at Balurghat held following night on 14th August, 1975 among themselves, when Major Farook ordered that none from the until shall go out without any order about 3-30 AM Risalder Mosleinuddin Dafadar Marfat Ali Shah LD Abul Hashem Mridhagot on a Bedford Truck. At midnight Major Khondaker Rashid of II Field Artillery came to their unit and Major Farook went out with him. After sometime Major Farook returned to the unit. Thereafter Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali and LD Abul Hashem Mridha got on a Bedford truck and asked the witness to follow them. He followed them' and stopped the vehicle at Mahakhali as some forces of Artillery were standing, an officer got into his Jeep. Some forces got also into his jeep. The convoy proceeded towards Farm-gate, then to Indira road and got on the, Mirpur Road. At Mirpur Road it proceeded towards south crossing Dhanmondi field into the West Dhanmondi and got on Sat-Masjid Road and proceeded towards south after zoinz little far got a lake by the left side. They proceeded by the south bank of lake towards east and stopped the jeep beside the truck. When the vehicle stopped Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali, LD Mridha and others went into a two storied building by the right side of the road. He was standing by the side of the Jeep. Some time thereafter he heard the sound of gun shots; thereafter Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali, LD Mridha swiftly came out. Thereafter the vehicle moved northwards across road No. 27 and again got on Mirpur road and stopped at the junction of Road No. 32. Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali, LD Mridha and others got out of the vehicle then the witness saw two tanks at the junction of road No. 32. It was dawn. At that time coming here heard the sound of gun shot towards the house of Bangabandhu. Thereafter Risaldar Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali, LD Mridha went towards the house of Bangabandhu. Some time thereafter Major Farook with a tank came out of road No. 32 and came to Mirpur road and asked us to go to the radio station; behind the tank came Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali, and LD Mridha. Lieutenant Kismat Hashem was with Major Farookinside the tank. Thereafter when Risalder Moslemuddin, Dafadar Marfat Ali and LD Mridha got on the Jeep they went to radio station. They all went inside the radio station and told him to keep the jeep by the side of the road. The army Chief will be corning here. Thereafter found Khondaker Moshtaq Ahmed, Major Khondaker Rashed and others entering the radio station. Then Major Shariful Hossain and Lieutenant Nazmul Hossain Ansar were in front of the radio station as the witness remembers. After some time Army, Navy and Air Chief came from the cantonment side; behind them Major Dalirn in an open jeep fitted with LMG came and they al went inside the radio station.
